    Lifestyle

    Performance

    M6 and M5 Pro.
    Fast and curious.

    Buckle up for Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro. Both chips are loaded with more CPU cores, so everything feels extra snappy and responsive. Next-level GPUs with hardware-accelerated ray tracing bring more graphics horsepower to everything from gaming to 3D modeling. And a powerful Neural Accelerator in each GPU core speeds up tasks like running on-device AI models, as well as editing photos and videos with built-in AI features in supported apps.

    Houdini, Claude, Figma Weave

    Seriously speedy and smart, M6 helps you tackle almost anything.

    Up to 4.8x faster than M44

    M5 Pro delivers even more power for demanding workflows.

    Up to 4x faster than M4 Pro5

    Make short work of everyday tasks, open and switch between apps seamlessly, and collaborate across apps like Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, Canva, Notion, and Keynote. Or use tools like LM Studio Bionic and Perplexity Personal Computer to create your own AI agents.

    Pursue hobbies, passions, and even pro-level creative projects like editing video in Final Cut Pro, beat-making and mixing music in Logic Pro, 3D modeling in Blender, AI upscaling in DaVinci Resolve, or designing in Adobe Photoshop.

    Analyze massive data sets in MATLAB, craft 2D and 3D models in Autodesk AutoCAD, or use apps like exo and LM Studio Bionic to run multiple AI agents across a cluster of Mac mini devices.

    Play new games like Mixtape and Crimson Desert. Or leverage hardware-accelerated ray tracing in titles like Control Ultimate Edition, Resident Evil 4, and Cyberpunk 2077 — for incredibly vibrant and realistic light, shadows, and reflections.

    Leverage on-device models in Xcode and utilize agents like Claude Code or Codex to be more productive. And build and test your app across multiple simulators quicker than ever.

    AI

    Apt for anything.

    Whether you’re outlining a presentation or fine-tuning your own large language model, Mac mini makes AI as accessible as it is powerful. Nearly every aspect of the M6 and M5 Pro chips is designed for AI — creating a platform that comprehensively unites hardware, software, and ecosystem.

    Create your own AI agents for anything from running a household to running a business. Mac mini enables fast, private, on-device inference. And has an expanded ecosystem of tools that let you build and use agents.

    Mac mini is optimized to handle the world’s most advanced AI apps. Run agentic apps like Claude Cowork and OpenClaw, LLM apps like Ollama and LM Studio Bionic, and photo enhancement apps like Topaz Photo.

    Find the right take in seconds in Pro Tools with local speech-to-text transcription. And in Adobe Photoshop, you can make complex image modifications using the Generative Fill feature.

    Perplexity Personal Computer, CapCut, Pages

    Topaz Photo

    Pro Tools with Auto-Align Post 2 plug-in

    Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. More personal. More powerful.

    Siri AI coming in English later this year.

    Apple Intelligence helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.18 Turn notes into a sprint agenda, surface an old edit just by describing the scene, or use Visual Intelligence to get details about a shoot location. And Siri AI is more helpful than ever, with richer answers, natural conversations, and a dedicated app.1

    Learn more about Apple Intelligence and Siri AI

    Siri AI.

    An entirely new version of Siri, powered by Apple Intelligence. It’s a profoundly more personal and capable assistant, and much more conversational, with a dedicated Siri app. And you can write and edit with Siri virtually anywhere you type, and use Visual Intelligence with Siri to learn about what’s in front of you.

    Describe a shortcut.

    Automate daily tasks with a simple description. Just describe what you need and Shortcuts connects actions across multiple apps to get it done.

    Visual Intelligence with Siri on Mac.

    Ask Siri about virtually anything on your Mac display with a dedicated keyboard shortcut, search visually, and take action, like adding multiple events to your calendar all in one go.

    Great powers come with great privacy.

    Apple Intelligence and Siri AI are designed to protect your privacy at every step. With powerful on-device processing, Apple Intelligence is aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. And with groundbreaking Private Cloud Compute, Apple Intelligence can draw on larger server-based models, without making your data accessible to Apple or anyone else.

    macOS

    Let your apps fly.

    Mac mini comes loaded with incredible built-in apps, industry-leading privacy and security, and amazing features for work and play. And macOS brings more speed and responsiveness to all your go-to apps — from Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook to Slack and Adobe Photoshop.

    Learn more about macOS

    Mac + iPhone

    One-two punch.

    When you use iPhone and Mac mini together, they work like magic. Make a call from the Phone app on your Mac and pick it up on your iPhone. Use your iPhone as a webcam or document scanner. And access your iPhone wirelessly with the iPhone Mirroring app in the Dock.19

    See and use what’s on your iPhone from your Mac, without having to reach for it.

    Wirelessly send photos, files, documents, and more between your iPhone, your Mac, and other nearby Apple devices.

    Copy text, images, photos, and videos on your iPhone and paste to your Mac — or vice versa.

    Accessories

    Plug and slay.

    Mac mini is designed to pair perfectly with Studio Display, Magic Keyboard, and Magic Mouse. But it’s also ready to work with displays and accessories you already own. So you can mix, match, and make Mac mini yours.

        Performance

        M6

        From rich presentations to full-on video production, M6 can power any pursuit. Super cores in the CPU boost single-threaded performance, making everyday tasks quick and responsive. And with Neural Accelerators in the GPU, faster unified memory, and our first-ever Dual 16-core Neural Engine, M6 is a powerhouse for all things AI — whether you’re applying style effects to photos instantly or creating AI agents that automate daily tasks.

        M5 Pro

        M5 Pro brings even more performance to creative and technical workloads. A next-generation 20-core GPU flies through everything from game development to AI-assisted rotoscoping. More unified memory means faster real-time rendering and faster AI token generation. And Thunderbolt 5 has transfer speeds up to 120Gb/s, supports up to three 6K displays, and lets you turn a stack of Mac mini devices into a cluster to run larger local AI models.

        Built to chill.

        It takes an advanced thermal architecture to put this much power in a small space. Within Mac mini, air is guided to different levels of the system, and all of it flows through the foot. Combined with Apple silicon’s unmatched power efficiency, this allows Mac mini to breeze through intensive workloads at incredible speeds. It’s calm, cool, and perfected.

        Recycled Material

        Our approach.

        Using recycled materials, like 100% recycled aluminum in the enclosure, reduces the need to mine new material, which avoids the carbon emissions and environmental impacts of mining.

        Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

        How you can help.

        You can protect the earth’s precious resources by trading in, passing down, or recycling devices and accessories you no longer use. You can bring them into any Apple Store for free, secure recycling. We also offer other ways to recycle, including mail-in options.

        Learn how to trade in or recycle devices

        Renewable Electricity

        Our approach.

        Using electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar across our global supply chain — instead of fossil fuels — significantly reduces carbon emissions from manufacturing Apple products.

        Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

        How you can help.

        To conserve energy, Mac desktops automatically sleep when the display is off. You can reduce energy consumption while your Mac is on and in use by enabling Low Power Mode. Go to System Settings > Energy to turn it on.

        Learn more about Low Power Mode

        Package and Ship

        Our approach.

        The shipping box of Mac mini (2026) has been optimized to transport 20% more units per trip compared to Mac mini (2024).

        Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

        How you can help.

        New Apple products come in paper packaging that’s 100% fiber-based. In most places, you can put the entire box into your household recycling bin. You can also bring Apple packaging to any Apple Store and we’ll recycle it for free.

        Learn more about recycling
